where.zh: 冰淇淋車任務：車上一路播放的叫賣音樂
where.en: Ice cream truck mission: the tune the truck plays while you drive

harness.notes: js/audio.js has no imports. audioInit() also starts the engine oscillators and tyre noise but at gain 0, so they are silent. The jingle runs on setInterval(190 ms).

skipped.what: engine, tyres, horn, sfx(), GPS speech

notes: The only music is the ice cream truck loop ('Turkey in the Straw'-style public-domain melody coded in jingleOn): 32 steps x 190 ms = 6.08 s, started by missions.js 'icecream' setup via M.jingle(true). The game has no other background music.
